# Vendored from TAMAS

Data and tool code in this directory are from the TAMAS benchmark
(https://github.com/microsoft/TAMAS), by Kavathekar, Jain, Rathod, Kumaraguru
and Ganu (arXiv:2511.05269).

- Code (`tools/*.py`): MIT License (see LICENSE.MIT).
- Data (`data/**`): Community Data License Agreement – Permissive – 2.0 (see LICENSE.CDLA-2.0).

Vendored here to test this project's reference monitor against the benchmark's
scenarios in LangGraph. Unmodified copies.
